scoring_justification: The agent runs DFT to compute total energies and then formation energies; the verifier cannot recompute the DFT, so T1 recompute is infeasible. We compare the agent's reported formation energies against the paper-reported values (T0) with tolerance for code difference.

hidden_assets.purpose: gold defect formation energies for all 36 combinations
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Tables II and III (Phys. Rev. B 93, 104111 (2016)). Energy differences in eV per supercell (20 atoms) as listed in the lower half of the tables.
hidden_assets.generation_method: extracted directly from the published tables
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: these are the paper's own reported values

schema.description: Each row is a unique (A,M,M_prime) combination. A is 'La' or 'Sr'. M and M_prime are transition-metal symbols from {Ti,V,Cr,Mn,Fe,Co} plus Ni for La. delta_E is the computed formation energy.

outputs.description: Antisite defect formation energies for all 36 perovskite interface combinations (21 La-based, 15 Sr-based).

output_contract.notes: The checker will compare the reported delta_E values against hidden gold values from the paper's Tables II and III (eV per supercell) using mean absolute error (MAE). Full credit for MAE ≤ 0.2 eV; partial credit for MAE ≤ 0.5 eV. Sign mismatches reduce credit. Missing combinations incur a proportional penalty.
